search.method: Public unauthenticated Sketchfab Data API search plus web search; listing metadata and public thumbnails only.
search.limitation: No new eligible listing states the required mattress dimensions. All are download-and-measure leads, none is an asserted fit or procurement specification. Published full-frame dimensions do not establish mattress size.

candidates.name: Modern bed
candidates.author: ArchVibe 3D
candidates.style_and_reservations: Padded fabric headboard and upholstered base; best new parents appearance. Neutral upholstery; walnut/brass absent, retain existing room accents.
candidates.bed_only_screen: Public thumbnail shows bed, mattress and bedding only; no freestanding tables, benches or rugs. Mesh contents/separability must be verified after lead download.
candidates.why_it_should_fit: Potential bed-only form suitable for this room style; required mattress 1.6 x 2.0 m must be measured at source size. No numerical fit can be predicted from unstated mattress dimensions.
candidates.status: awaiting lead download and real-size mattress/bed-only/C8/neutral review; no fit scale allowed

excluded_examples.reason: Free Standard / NoAI, not CC0 or CC-BY.
Thumbnail includes loose laptops/toys, no separable-extra proof.
Listing thumbnail uses bright placeholder material colours; appearance unsuitable for parents.
Dark rustic bed and plaid dressing, not light oak Scandinavian.
120x200 dimensions stated, paid/store model, no CC0/CC-BY download.
Title Hopen Bed 160 gives width only; timber design does not satisfy upholstered parents headboard.
